rules.plain_text: The def:CommentOID attribute must be provided for an ItemDef when its ItemOID is referenced in an ItemRef that has the def:HasNoData  attribute  value 'Yes'.
rules.rule: //ItemDef/@def:CommentOID must be provided when at least one //ItemRef[@ItemOID=ItemDef/@OID]/@def:HasNoData="Yes".
rules.message: ItemDef[@OID]/@def:CommentOID is not provided  when ItemGroupDef[@OID]/ItemRef[@ItemOID] has def:HasNoData attribute set to  'Yes'.

rules.plain_text: No more than one child element Description may be provided for the def:Origin element.
rules.rule: No more than one //def:OriginDef/Description may be provided.
rules.message: ItemDef[@OID]/def:Origin[@Type] has count(def:Origin/Description)  Description child elements. Only 1 is permitted.

rules.plain_text: No more than one CodeList/Description may be provided.
rules.rule: CodeList[@OID]  has count(CodeList[@OID]/Description) Description child elements.
rules.message: CodeList[@OID]  has count(CodeList[@OID]/Description) Description child elements. Only 1 is permitted.

rules.plain_text: No more than one Description child element may be provided for an EnumeratedItem element.
rules.rule: CodeList[@OID]/EnumeratedItem[@CodedValue] has count(CodeList[@OID]/EnumeratedItem[@CodedValue]/Description) child elements.
rules.message: CodeList[@OID]/EnumeratedItem[@CodedValue] has count(CodeList[@OID]/EnumeratedItem[@CodedValue]/Description) child elements. Only 1 is permitted.

rules.plain_text: No more than one //CodeListItem/Description may be provided.
rules.rule: count(CodeList[@OID]/CodeListItem[@CodedValue]/Description) > 1
rules.message: CodeList[@OID/CodeListItem[@CodedValue] has count(CodeList[@OID]/CodeListItem[@CodedValue]/Description) Description child elements. Only 1 is permitted.

rules.plain_text: Attribute xlink:href must be provided.
rules.rule: def:leaf[@ID]/@xlink:href is missing.
rules.message: def:leaf[@ID] is missing the xlink:href attribute.

rules.plain_text: There must be an Alias element with the Context Attribute nci:ExtCodeID when the Codelist includes a reference to a CDISC Controlled Terminology Standard.
rules.rule: if Codelist/@def:StandardOID is non-null, count(Alias[@Context='nci:ExtCodeID'] = 1.
rules.message: Missing Alias element with Context attribute 'nci:ExtCodeID' for CodeList[@OID] with def:Standard = //def:Standard[@OID=CodeList/@def:StandardOID]/@Name.

rules.plain_text: No more than one ExternalCodeList element may be provided for a CodeList element.
rules.rule: count(CodeList[@OID]/ExternalCodeList)>1.
rules.message: CodeLists may have only one ExternalCodeList. CodeList[@OID]  has count(Codelist/ExternalCodeList) ExternalCodeList child elements.

rules.plain_text: The value of the Purpose attribute must be "Tabulation" for an ItemGroupDef element that represents a dataset defined as following an SDTMIG or SENDIG standard.
rules.rule: //ItemGroupDef/@Purpose must be "Tabulation" where def:Standard/@Name begins with "SDTM" or "SEND" and   ItemGroupDef[@def:StandardOID = def:Standard/@OID].
rules.message: The Purpose attribute for ItemGroupDef[@Name] is not "Tabulation" but the dataset follows the def:Standard[OID=ItemGroupDef/@def:StandardOID]/@Name.

rules.plain_text: The value of the Purpose attribute must be "Analysis" for an ItemGroupDef element that represents a dataset defined as following a ADaMIG standard.
rules.rule: //ItemGroupDef/@Purpose must be "Analysis" where def:Standard/@Name = "ADaMIG" and   ItemGroupDef[@def:StandardOID = def:Standard/@OID].
rules.message: The Purpose attribute for ItemGroupDef[@Name] is not "Analysis" but the dataset follows the [def:Standard[OID=ItemGroupDef/@def:StandardOID]/@Name] standard.

rules.plain_text: A valid CreationDateTime attribute  must be provided for the ODM element.
rules.rule: ODM@CreationDateTime must be provided.
rules.message: The ODM CreationDateTime attribue  is missing or invalid.

rules.plain_text: Attribute FileType must be provided for the ODM element.
rules.rule: @FileType must be provided.
rules.message: Attribute FileType is missing for element ODM.

rules.plain_text: The def:CommentOID attribute on the def:Standard element must reference an existing def:CommentDef element.
rules.rule: A def:CommentDef element must exist with def:CommentDef/@OID = //def:Standard/@CommentOID.
rules.message: There is no def:CommentDef with an OID attribute that matches def:Standard[@Name]/def:CommentOID.

rules.plain_text: Attribute OID must be provided for the def:Standard element.
rules.rule: @OID must be provided.
rules.message: Attribute OID is missing for element def:Standard[@Name].

rules.plain_text: Child element def:Standard must be provided for the def:Standards element.
rules.rule: //def:Standards/def:Standard must be provided.
rules.message: Child element def:Standard is missing for element def:Standards.

rules.plain_text: The value of attribute ID must start with either a letter or underscore (_), and may contain only letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and periods.
rules.rule: The value of @ID must start with either a letter or underscore (_), and may contain only letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and periods.
rules.message: The value of attribute ID[@ID] does not start with either a letter or underscore (_) or contains characters other than letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and periods.

rules.plain_text: The value of the Repeating attribute must be "No", when IsReferenceData="Yes".
rules.rule: The value of the @Repeating attribute must be "No", when @IsReferenceData="Yes".
rules.message: The value of Repeating[@Repeating] must be "No" when IsReferenceData="Yes".

rules.plain_text: Value of the Name attribute in the def:SubClass must be one of the values from the CDISC/NCI subclass codelists.
rules.rule: Value of def:SubClass/@Name must be in the CDISC/NCI Subclass codelists, with C-Codes C165635, C165636, C176227, and any other subclass C-Code that is included in the applicable schema.
rules.message: The value of SubClass Name [@Name] for dataset [$ParentItemGroupDef/@Name] is not in the CDISC/NCI subclass codelists.

rules.plain_text: Value of the ParentClass attribute in the def:Class must be one of the values from the CDISC/NCI Class or Subclass codelists.
rules.rule: Value of def:SubClass/@ParentClass must be in the CDISC/NCI Class, with C-Code C103329, Subclass codelists, with C-Codes C165635, C165636, C176227 or any other subclass C-Code that is included in the applicable schema.
rules.message: The value of SubClass ParentClass [@ParentClass] for dataset [$ParentItemGroupDef/@Name] is not in the CDISC/NCI class or subclass codelists.

rules.plain_text: The version identifier must match a version identifier used in the standard.
rules.rule: @Version must match a version identifier available for @Name.
rules.message: The version identifier value is not a valid value for the standard def:Standard[@Name] .

rules.plain_text: The value of the Status attribute must be one of the values from the CDISC/NCI standard Status codelist included in the Define-XML Controlled Terminology.
rules.rule: The value of @Status must be in the CDISC/NCI Standard Status codelist with C-Code C172332.
rules.message: The value of Standard Status [@Status] is not in the CDISC/NCI Standard Status codelist (C-Code C172332) for Define-XML.

rules.plain_text: The value of the English dataset's description must match the one specified in the CDISC standard for an ItemGroupDef element that represents a dataset defined as following an SDTMIG or SENDIG standard.
rules.rule: //ItemGroupDef/Description/TranslatedText, when @xml:lang is not provided or @xml:lang="en", must match the one specified in the CDISC standard referenced by def:Standard/@Name and def:Standard/@Version, where def:Standard/@Name begins with "SDTM" or "SEND" and ItemGroupDef[@def:StandardOID = def:Standard/@OID].
rules.message: The English dataset's description for ItemGroupDef[@Name] does not follow the standard [def:Standard/[OID=ItemGroupDef/@def:StandardOID]/@Name] [def:Standard[OID=ItemGroupDef/@def:StandardOID]/@Version].

rules.plain_text: The value of an English variable's description must match the one specified in the CDISC standard for an ItemDef element that represents a dataset's variable defined as following an SDTMIG or SENDIG standard.
rules.rule: //ItemDef/Description/TranslatedText, when @xml:lang is not provided or @xml:lang="en", must match the one specified in the CDISC standard referenced by def:Standard/@Name and def:Standard/@Version, where def:Standard/@Name begins with "SDTM" or "SEND" .
rules.message: The English variable's description for ItemGroupDef[@Name], ItemDef[@Name] does not follow the def:Standard[OID=ItemGroupDef/@def:StandardOID]/@Name and def:Standard[OID=ItemGroupDef/@def:StandardOID]/@Version.
